Hard-coded hex, not a design-system color
400 12px/18px — Helper text, captions; error text with `text-destructive`.
500 13px/20px — Buttons (all sizes), form labels; Table cell (key column), tags.

notes.blue-20: Lightest blue. The value behind `accent`: hover rows, selected items.
notes.blue-30: Blue scale — primary / action. Use as `bg-blue-30`, `text-blue-30`, `border-blue-30`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.blue-40: Blue scale — primary / action. Use as `bg-blue-40`, `text-blue-40`, `border-blue-40`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.blue-50: Blue scale — primary / action. Use as `bg-blue-50`, `text-blue-50`, `border-blue-50`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.

notes.blue-80: Blue scale — primary / action. Use as `bg-blue-80`, `text-blue-80`, `border-blue-80`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.blue-90: Blue Base. Brand action colour; the value behind `primary`. White text on it passes (5.9:1).
notes.blue-100: Darkest blue (not a light tint as in Tailwind's default). The value behind `accent-foreground`; text on `blue-20`.
notes.gray-40: Gray scale — main UI neutral. Use as `bg-gray-40`, `text-gray-40`, `border-gray-40`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.gray-60: Gray scale — main UI neutral. Use as `bg-gray-60`, `text-gray-60`, `border-gray-60`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.gray-80: The value behind `muted-foreground`: helper text, placeholders, meta. 3.96:1 on white — below 4.5:1 for small text; kept exact from the source, prefer `gray-100` where small text must pass AA.
notes.gray-100: Darkest gray; secondary text that must pass AA at small sizes (6.0:1 on white).
notes.black: Brand black. The value behind `foreground`: main text on white and offwhite surfaces (12.2:1 on white).
notes.white: The value behind `background`, `card`, `popover` and every `*-foreground` on a saturated fill.
notes.offwhite-10: Offwhite scale — backgrounds and borders. Use as `bg-offwhite-10`, `text-offwhite-10`, `border-offwhite-10`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.offwhite-20: Offwhite scale — backgrounds and borders. Use as `bg-offwhite-20`, `text-offwhite-20`, `border-offwhite-20`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.offwhite-40: The value behind `secondary` and `muted`: subtle fills, secondary buttons.
notes.offwhite-60: Offwhite scale — backgrounds and borders. Use as `bg-offwhite-60`, `text-offwhite-60`, `border-offwhite-60`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.offwhite-80: Offwhite scale — backgrounds and borders. Use as `bg-offwhite-80`, `text-offwhite-80`, `border-offwhite-80`; inside components prefer the semantic tokens.
notes.offwhite-100: The value behind `border`: cards, tables, dividers.
